description: New Zealand Transmission System Models (North & South Islands) is a grid model dataset listed in Awesome Grid Model Data, a curated list of electricity grid model datasets under the section "PSSE (`.raw`) > New Zealand Electricity Authority (EA)", published or maintained by New Zealand Electricity Authority. Representative PSSE.sav and.raw files of New Zealand's transmission system. Separate models for North Island and South Island. Coverage: the power system named in the entry. The list files it under New Zealand Electricity Authority and gives it in PSSE, PowerFactory formats, with 2 links. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-flow, dynamic-stability and production-cost model studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-grid-model-data.
